title: Self-host guide: run your own OpenAgents (web, API, relay) from the public repo
body:
From the Kitchen Sink X-archive pass (#11125, docs/kitchen-sink/twitter.md, item 8). Posts promise 'open access always … no rugpull possible' and that anyone can run their own copy. Ledger K5 is Partial: the code is open, but there is no guide.

- docs/self-host.md (and a page on openagents.com/docs): what you need, how to run the web app, account service, inference gateway, and Nostr relay from the public repo, with your own model keys.
- One command or script per component where possible; what's optional.
- Tested by someone following it on a clean Linux machine.

Done when: a clean-machine run reaches a working chat with the guide alone.

Ledger: K5, K4, K7. Phase: late October.
